referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A bright product-equipment composition and centered booking action lead into a blue local-service heading on white. Narrow local address/phone strip, simple home-gallery-services-contact links and a booking route. All-caps aqua headings, compact dark body copy and utilitarian plain service lists. The page sequence runs from equipment-led opening to local company introduction to service index toward review scene, partner strip, cityline footer. Equipment montage opens; community mark strip, review overlay and city skyline close later chapters. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
